title: Witnessed projection square along one proper refinement
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, C its coefficient datum, E/Q_C.l a finite extension, and n>=0. Let X,Y be finite-type quasi-compact schemes over D.k, and f:X->Y a separated finite-type quasi-compact morphism over D.k. For compactifications c,d of f, any proper refinement r:c→d, boundedConstructible K on X and finiteTor L on Y, refinementLaw holds: for every retained origin presentation e of K and eT of T=K tensor Lf*L, PF_c(K,L) followed by theta(r,T,eT) equals (theta(r,K,e) tensor identity_L) followed by PF_d(K,L). The refinement square need not be Cartesian and no projection morphism is inverted.

proof.text: Apply the finite clause of refinementProjectionCounit on the bundled finite-type schemes. It gives the square for the directed comparison on all unbounded inputs.

At K and tensorInput, normalized_refinement_inverse identifies the directed comparison with the inverse witnessed theta. The native_component_eq reflexivity lemma writes the exact native projections in their explicit tensor coordinates. At a generic coefficient ring, precompose the desired equation with the tensor of theta_K.inv. Use the directed equation, postcompose with theta_T.hom, and cancel the two inverse pairs by functoriality. Specialize this proved categorical cancellation lemma to the specified coefficient quotient. No projection arrow is inverted.

lean.statement:
theorem refinement_square
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[C.l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[C.l] E]
    (n : ℕ) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c d : Compactification f) (r : c.Refinement d)
    (K : (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).FullSubcategory)
    (L : (finiteTor C.l E n Y).FullSubcategory) :
    refinementLaw C.l E n c d r K L
